title: MemoryExportsGetRequest
description: Fetch one export chunk. Callers fetch chunks 0..chunk_count-1 and verify chunk_digest per chunk and bundle_digest on reassembly (§6.13). Grant: transfer (same coverage as creation). Read-only; the response payload is returned directly (§7.0.2).

chunk_ordinal.description: Chunk ordinal to fetch; 0-based, below chunk_count.
